? RD-5 rider agreed to this route before the detour; scope of that agreement [F3] RULE: exempt only if a RIDER message sent before 09:47:50 agrees AND the agreement covers this segment. Three kinds of agreement: (1) GENERAL route choice ('take whichever way is faster') covers a route chosen to get there, not an errand of the driver's own (a stop away from the route, a loop that reaches nothing: counts). (3) Scope unclear: undetermined. A driver's claim of agreement that appears only in his statement is not consent (G11); a complete chat record with no rider agreement before the segment: counts. events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $2.74 (model confidence 0.85)
events.body:
RydeTAXI trip, so metered distance feeds the fare directly [F6][RD-2]. The trace settles RD-1 (one off-route segment exists) and RD-4 as failed: only speed-band 4 records exist and no incident near the route, so no "reasonable cause" exemption [F3][F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. RD-6 likewise fails: no prior upheld route dispute [F15][RD-6].

RD-5: the only chat message is the rider's 09:35 locator, which is not a route agreement of any kind, before or after the segment [F7][F8] — a general authorization, a named road, or anything else is absent; a driver-side claim of agreement cannot supply consent [F9][RD-5][G11]. So the segment counts; I do not need a road name and the finding is not undetermined (the complete record settles it). RD-3 does not apply: no stop is measured in the segment and the rider named no stop on it [F7][RD-3]. The segment therefore is an unexcused off-route segment [F3][RD-1].

Amount: RD-2 refunds only the unexcused segment's extra km at the trip's per-km rate, using the rate as the fare record states it: $18.50 ÷ 13.12 km = $1.41006/km (unrounded); 1.94 km × $1.41006/km = $2.7355 → $2.74 [F3][F4][F6][RD-2]. The remaining actual-vs-optimal gap (2.4 vs 1.94 km) and the driver's 3.83-vs-1.89 km figure [F4] are not refunded: per RD-2 only the unexcused segment's own extra_km is recoverable.

Safety screen: the chat, the statement and the complaint contain no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation; the only hint word is the rider's pickup locator "I'll find you at the kerb outside Mandarin Gallery", plainly a meet-up arrangement [F7][F9][SAFE-1]. Evidence is sufficient: the chat record is complete and timestamped [F8], the segment is measured [F3], and the fare components are recorded [F6].

Because this was a metered RydeTAXI trip, the extra distance affected the fare, and $2.74 is being issued to the rider as a Ryde voucher. This has been noted on your record. There is no flag on your account this time, since you have no prior upheld route dispute.
